name: vinac-link
description: A secure link between AI agents on your computers, no cloud or internet needed. Pair nearby computers with one Allow on each; send encrypted messages, requests, files and git branches through a firewall you control. Secrets are never returned to agents.

interface.shortDescription: Encrypted messages between agents on your paired computers
interface.longDescription: Pair this computer with another one by sound (or a typed code) and a two-way 6-digit code check. Agents can then send each other encrypted messages, intent-checked requests, files up to 64 MB and git branches, directly over Wi-Fi, a hotspot or a cable, with no server and no internet. Each person's firewall decides what reaches their agent. People can send API keys between the devices; agent tools only ever see their names.
